title: BeyondForms demo persona
description: A reviewable fixture describing one demo account: the `users` row, its application, its documents, and the research context that the database cannot hold. Materialised by src/services/demo_seed_service.py.

slug.description: Stable identifier. Must match the filename stem.

phone_number.description: Must be a Bundesnetzagentur drama number so is_test_account() accepts it. See libs/auth/src/beyondforms/auth/test_accounts.py.

source.description: Repo-relative path to the research document this persona is derived from.

portrait.description: Path relative to demo/personas/. Synthetic likeness for documentation only; never stored in the database or used as a document blob.

scenario.description: What this persona is for — which part of the process it exercises.

profile.description: Keys must be `users` column names, or `associated_persons` (a relationship, whose entries follow AssociatedPersonSchema). Values must satisfy the DB enums. Validated in tests/test_demo_personas.py.

applications.description: One entry per form_type this persona needs scoped `form_data` for. Each is get-or-created by form_type. Documents attach to the first entry's row (user_documents has a single fk_application_id).

document_type.description: Frontend slot id, as written by src/worker.py. Not a document-intelligence registry name.

display_name.description: Human filename. German keywords in it are load-bearing for the frontend's slot matching.

asset.description: Either a filename resolved against DEMO_ASSETS_PATH, or an instruction to generate a watermarked demo PDF from raw_data.

raw_data.description: Validated against the document-intelligence schema for this slot's registry type (extra='forbid'). Computed fields such as health_insurance_proof.is_private must NOT appear.

user_error_code.description: Only meaningful for failed / ready_for_review documents. These four are the codes DatenPrufenForm.tsx renders a message for.
